messages:
nina: heads-up: onboarding sampleapp failed in a private deployment test. REST curl works, SDK gets 401 and then our retry middleware replays the request which made it worse. repro below.

nina: curl (works)
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://private-host/v1/models/list
# -> 200 OK
```

nina: sampleapp (broken)
```
// sampleapp uses sdk client created from env
const c = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.SDK_KEY })
await c.models.list() // -> throws 401
// our retry layer then retries and support saw repeated 401s in logs
```

omar: interesting. our SDK has historical support for two auth worlds: Bearer tokens and legacy X-Api-Key header. Private infra disables custom headers but allows Authorization. if sampleapp is emitting X-Api-Key then private envs will 401.

omar: also the retry behavior is wrong: we only want to retry on 5xx or idempotent network errors, not on 401. looks like the auth refresh hook erroneously treats 401 as refreshable.

nina: exact. repro shows sdk sends `x-api-key: <key>` header. curl uses Authorization. curious why sampleapp wiring picks the header path.

zhen: i checked onboarding helpers: in onboarding/helpers/auth.js we map SDK_KEY -> { 'X-Api-Key': key } for backwards compatibility. that was added ages ago. we should prefer Authorization: Bearer when SDK_KEY looks like a JWT (has dots) or when env var is named BEARER_TOKEN.

zhen: plan: 1) update auth helper to prefer Authorization: Bearer if token looks like JWT or BEARER_TOKEN set; fall back to X-Api-Key for legacy keys. 2) fix retry middleware to not retry on 401 (also add log markers). 3) add unit test covering private deployment behavior (mock server that rejects X-Api-Key but accepts Authorization). 4) patch sampleapp README to call out env var names and a small CI e2e step to run in a private-like stub.

omar: agree. also add a lint in CI that searches for direct header sets of X-Api-Key in sample apps so we don't regress.

tess: small UX ask: can we surface a clearer error in SDK when 401 occurs in private envs? Something like: "401 Unauthorized — try using BEARER_TOKEN or set Authorization header; X-Api-Key may be blocked in private deployments." That'll reduce support noise.

zhen: good idea. i'll add a helper error message for auth failures that includes a short remediation hint.

nina: thanks. customers running the onboarding flow hit this early so high priority. can we target a patch release for the sampleapp + SDK 0.10.x this week?

omar: yes, i'll open the PRs and coordinate releases for node/python. tagging @devex-bot to create tracking issue.

devex-bot: Created issue #3789: "SDK/sampleapp: prefer Authorization: Bearer for JWT-like tokens; do not retry on 401; improve error message" assigned to zhen, priority: high. https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/3789 :white_check_mark:

nina: one more follow-up: add a tiny test in onboarding CI that runs against the private stub (no X-Api-Key allowed). that will catch regressions early.

omar: added to the rollout plan. will post PRs when ready. :rocket:
